title: 食品安全国家标准 食品添加剂使用标准 (National food safety standard: Standard for uses of food additives), GB 2760—2024
authors: National Health Commission of the People's Republic of China; State Administration for Market Regulation
journal: National standard of the People's Republic of China, issued 8 February 2024, in force from 8 February 2025, replacing GB 2760—2014
funder: Issued by the National Health Commission and the State Administration for Market Regulation; the standard carries no funding statement. The text was read in a copy hosted by a third party, as the issuing bodies' sites refused automated access; its title page, contents and Table A.1 are those of GB 2760—2024.
result: Table A.1, ascorbic acid (vitamin C), CNS 04.014, INS 300, functions flour treatment agent and antioxidant: used in various foods in appropriate amounts according to production needs (按生产需要适量使用), except the food categories numbered 1 to 5, 10 to 62 and 68 in Table A.2, which comprise milks, fermented milk, milk powder and cream, butter, fresh fruit, vegetables, fungi and algae, cereals, rice, flours and raw noodles, fresh meat, aquatic products, eggs, sugars, honey, salt, spices, infant formulae and complementary foods for infants, drinking waters, fruit and vegetable juices, tea and coffee; maximum 5.0 g/kg in peeled or pre-cut fresh fruit (04.01.01.03) and in peeled, cut or shredded vegetables (04.02.01.03), 0.2 g/kg in wheat flour (06.03.01) and 1.5 g/kg in fruit and vegetable juices (14.02.01), as ready to drink. Table A.1, sodium carbonate (碳酸钠, CNS 01.302, INS 500(i)), function acidity regulator: according to production needs in various foods except categories 1 to 30 and 33 to 68 in Table A.2, and in fermented rice products; categories 31 and 32 are raw wet and raw dry noodle products. Sodium hydrogen carbonate (碳酸氢钠, CNS 06.001, INS 500(ii)), functions raising agent, acidity regulator and stabiliser: according to production needs in various foods except categories 1 to 56 and 58 to 68 in Table A.2, and in fermented rice products; category 57 is cereal-based complementary foods for infants and young children. Sodium sesquicarbonate (碳酸氢三钠, also named 倍半碳酸钠, CNS 01.305, INS 500(iii)), function acidity regulator: according to production needs in dairy products other than listed exceptions, only goat milk, and in pastries (07.02) and biscuits (07.03). Table A.1, phospholipids (磷脂, CNS 04.010, INS 322), functions antioxidant and emulsifier: according to production needs in various foods, except the categories numbered 1 to 4, 6, 8 to 53 and 59 to 68 in Table A.2, which comprise pasteurised and sterilised milk, fermented milk, milk and cream powder, vegetable oil, animal fats, butter, fresh fruit, vegetables, fungi and algae, cereals, rice, flours and noodle products, fresh, chilled and frozen meat, aquatic products, eggs, sugars, honey, salt, spices, drinking waters, fruit and vegetable juices, wines, and tea and coffee; cream (category 5), hydrogenated vegetable oil (7) and infant formulae and complementary foods for infants (54 to 58) are not among the exceptions. Table A.1, mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids (单,双甘油脂肪酸酯, CNS 10.006, INS 471), functions emulsifier and coating agent (乳化剂、被膜剂): according to production needs in various foods, except the 59 categories numbered 1 to 4, 6 to 11, 13 to 14, 16 to 30, 32 to 53 and 59 to 68 in Table A.2; cream (5), surface-treated fresh fruit (12) and vegetables (15), raw wet noodle products (31) and infant formulae and complementary foods for infants (54 to 58) are not among the exceptions; maximum 20.0 g/kg in butter and concentrated butter (02.02.01.01), 30.0 g/kg in raw dry noodle products (06.03.02.02), 6.0 g/kg in brown sugar, raw sugar, other sugars and syrups (11.01.02) and 5.0 g/kg in spices (12.09). Table A.1, phosphoric acid and phosphates (磷酸及磷酸盐), a group entry that includes disodium dihydrogen pyrophosphate (焦磷酸二氢二钠), tetrasodium pyrophosphate (焦磷酸钠), tetrapotassium pyrophosphate (焦磷酸四钾), trisodium monohydrogen diphosphate (焦磷酸一氢三钠) and calcium acid pyrophosphate (酸式焦磷酸钙); its INS numbers include 450(i), 450(ii), 450(iii), 450(v) and 450(vii); functions water-retention agent, raising agent, acidity regulator, stabiliser, coagulant and anticaking agent (水分保持剂、膨松剂、酸度调节剂、稳定剂、凝固剂、抗结剂). Maximum levels apply singly or in combination, expressed as phosphate (PO4 3-), for example 5.0 g/kg in dairy products other than listed exceptions, 15.0 g/kg in bakery wares (07.0), 5.0 g/kg in prepared and cooked meat products, 20.0 g/kg in non-dairy creamer and compound seasonings and 80.0 g/kg in seasoning packets for instant wet noodles (12.10.01.03); in infant formulae (13.01.01, 13.01.02) and complementary foods for infants and young children (13.02), 1.0 g/kg using only calcium hydrogen phosphate and sodium dihydrogen phosphate.
